panels.title: Service graph (kB/s, both directions)
panels.description: Nodes are workloads, edges are TCP connections seen by netflow. The number is throughput in both directions.

targets.expr: sum by (id, title, subtitle) (label_replace(label_replace(label_join(((sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_sent_bytes_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_sent_bytes_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_received_bytes_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_received_bytes_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))) / 1000), "id", "/", "source_workload_namespace", "source_workload"), "title", "$1", "source_workload", "(.*)"), "subtitle", "$1", "source_workload_namespace", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_join(((sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_sent_bytes_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_sent_bytes_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_received_bytes_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_received_bytes_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))) / 1000), "id", "/", "destination_workload_namespace", "destination_workload"), "title", "$1", "destination_workload", "(.*)"), "subtitle", "$1", "destination_workload_namespace", "(.*)"))

label_join(label_join(label_join(((sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_sent_bytes_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_sent_bytes_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_received_bytes_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_received_bytes_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))) / 1000), "source", "/", "source_workload_namespace", "source_workload"), "target", "/", "destination_workload_namespace", "destination_workload"), "id", " > ", "source", "target")

panels.title: Edges
panels.description: One row per edge. The Istio columns are filled for meshed edges only.

targets.expr: sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_sent_bytes_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_sent_bytes_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_received_bytes_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_received_bytes_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (netflow_tcp_connections_open{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"} or netflow_tcp_connections_open{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"})

sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_connections_opened_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_connections_opened_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_connect_failures_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_connect_failures_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_retransmits_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_retransmits_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_rtt_seconds_bucket{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_rtt_seconds_bucket{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source", source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source", destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source", response_code=~"5..", source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source", response_code=~"5..", destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source", source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source", destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Throughput, top 10 edges
panels.description: Bytes per second in both directions.

targets.expr: topk(10, (sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_sent_bytes_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_sent_bytes_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_received_bytes_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_received_bytes_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Retransmits, top 10 edges
panels.description: Retransmitted segments per second. Sustained values point at packet loss on that path.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_retransmits_total{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_retransmits_total{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Round-trip time p99, top 10 edges
panels.description: Network round-trip time as the kernel measures it, without application time.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_workload) (rate(netflow_tcp_rtt_seconds_bucket{source_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(netflow_tcp_rtt_seconds_bucket{destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))))
